abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: Configure Tracked Devices
init.description:
You can use the service `dbus_bluetooth_tracker.scan_nearby_devices` to scan and detect nearby bluetooth MACs. Results will be shown in persistent notifications.

Please enter the tracking options below:

data.tracked_macs: Tracked MAC list (comma or newline separated)
data.seen_interval_seconds: Cooldown scan skip for recently seen devices (seconds, 0=disabled)
data.consider_home: Consider home delay (seconds) - timeout before marked away
